boss_summary: The exact frozen V3 draft is rejected and must remain append-only evidence. The implementation does preserve several design improvements, including closed canonical byte parsing, detached digest recomputation, NTFS link_count one, non-authorizing machine labels, broad prepare/publish value continuity, receipt-class separation, and honest formal-test coverage_unavailable. Those positives do not qualify the bundle. The policy is not bound to the exact Hosea static allowlist, cannot represent its root and one-component paths or five unchanged governed members, accepts asserted rather than calculated artifact topology, lacks stable executable identity/hash allowlists, omits causal chronology, and cannot establish complete process evidence. The native helper exports an arbitrary-path write/delete-open probe, retains insufficient root and cleanup identity, samples ancestry rather than closing bounded process relations, takes architecture from mutable environment state, overstates path nonaccess, and lacks required adversarial coverage. The allowlist validator is not semantically closed, and the model-root parent relationship is not tied to the exact frozen model identity. No production launcher should be drafted on top of these exact hashes.

policy_peer_finding_adjudication.rationale: A trusted execution-freeze digest authenticates whatever rows were frozen; it does not prove those rows were deterministically projected from the exact static allowlist. A structurally valid different 13-plus-3 set demonstrably passes.

The exact current allowlist contains root-relative sentinel forms, a one-component receipts parent, and five preimage-equals-staged members that the policy rejects. Unspecified prefixing, omission, or reinterpretation would change the governed scope.
Closed booleans describing topology are not graph proof. Required-dependency subset checking admits extra nodes without typed stages or cycle calculation.
Continuity of arbitrary executable_identity strings preserves an attacker-selected identity. It does not prove current or controller binaries equal pre-reviewed stable file identities and hashes.
Per-capture inclusion and freshness do not prove checker start-before-end or prepare-before-publish causal order. Both demonstrated reversals violate the lease protocol.

The pure policy cannot observe an omitted bounded writer and the current collector evidence does not prove complete bounded enumeration. Honest non-exhaustive labels prevent overclaiming but do not satisfy the corrected implementation gate.

native_peer_finding_adjudication.rationale: The exported helper accepts any Path and requests GENERIC_WRITE or DELETE access before fixture containment is established. Current tests exercising only a UUID temp leaf do not make the function fail-closed.
native_peer_finding_adjudication.qualification_effect: The exact native artifact cannot enter a qualified component lock or reviewed test bundle. It may be retained only as rejected evidence until a new generation makes the primitive private and handle-bound or proves containment before any open.

native_peer_finding_adjudication.rationale: Path resolution plus UUID naming does not retain identity. Full-path workspace open, pathname membership enumeration, and pathname-based recursive cleanup leave rename/substitution and cleanup-target races.

The helper honestly provides test-only ancestry evidence, so this is not evidence fraud. It remains insufficient for production reuse or component qualification because it does not bind every bounded process row, executable hash, and parent relation or fail on partial inventory.
PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE is mutable diagnostic input, not a native OS fact. Production-relevant architecture must come from Windows APIs with exact error handling.

The helper opens a volume root and process executable paths while recording canonical_or_global_path_opened false. Even if global meant only the three model-global sentinels, the field is too broad and the evidence scope is ambiguous.

Direct Windows function success is useful lower-grade draft evidence but does not exercise the intended production primitive, formal harness, integrated reparse chain rejection, identity substitution, process uncertainty, or cleanup races.

A whole-file hash proves identity of the current bytes, not semantic validity of a future regenerated allowlist. The validator's reusable claim requires closed nested source and normalization objects, exact IDs/roles, duplicate-key rejection, and Windows-normalized uniqueness.

Replacing an unchanged file adds a rename/lost-update surface without changing governed bytes. Preserve all 13 as the ordered governed Hosea set, but classify the five exact preimage-equals-staged rows as guarded nonreplacement members. The mutation tuple contains only the eight changed rows. The five guarded rows remain under exact identity, size, hash, link-count, sentinel-like continuity and final validation but receive no forward replace call.

root_crosscheck_finding_adjudication.rationale: This independently corroborates POLICY-X-004. The next generation must freeze and compare structured current/controller executable file identities and SHA-256 values.
A logical model-root parent must resolve to the exact frozen model-root handle identity. Same-volume membership or a separately supplied parent identity is not sufficient.

The ancestry sampler may remain rejected test evidence, but no production collector may reuse it as bounded process closure. The separate arbitrary-path export additionally blocks qualification of the exact test helper bundle.
Exact file hashing does not replace closed semantic validation for a reusable loader or future allowlist generation.

minimum_new_generation_repairs.requirement: Bind canonical static-allowlist bytes and detached hash as an exact dependency. Define and test one deterministic projection to execution-freeze rows, including exact ID, role, order, source-render, normalized token, parent and leaf relations, hashes, sizes, link policy, missing/extra/reordered rejection and model-root identity binding.

Define an explicit non-escaping model-root parent representation that accepts the three root sentinels and one-component receipts parent without permitting dot, dotdot, drive, ADS or normalization escape. Preserve 13 governed members but split eight changed replacement members from five guarded nonreplacement members; prove the latter receive no rename or write.

Replace topology booleans and required-subset dependencies with an exact typed node/edge graph, exact dependency sets, legal stage ordering and deterministic direct/transitive cycle rejection. Preserve the external trust anchor and prohibit unknown post-component nodes.

Freeze sorted permitted current/controller executable normalized names, file identities and SHA-256 values. Measure all live values by retained handles. Enumerate and classify the complete code-fixed bounded process set; bind PID plus creation time, executable identity/hash and parent relation; block partial, inaccessible, exited, ambiguous or unclassified rows; retain strict non-exhaustive-writer dissent.

Enforce start less than or equal to end for every wall and monotonic interval, all required observation ordering, same post-restart boot, prepare capture and validation before publish capture and validation, monotonic nondecrease, and same live lease identity. Add each reversed-order counterexample.

Remove or privatize arbitrary-path effect helpers. Any contention probe must accept only a retained verified fixture lease/parent handle and exact allowed leaf, with outside-root rejection before any open. Retain test-root, workspace, model and parent handle identities; enumerate membership through handles; identity-bind cleanup; never recursively delete a merely path-matching substitute.

Use native Windows APIs for host and process architecture. Split canonical governed target, model-global sentinel, disposable fixture, volume metadata/root and process executable access claims. Limit zero-delta claims to exact measured fixture bytes/members and disclose metadata/hydration uncertainty.

Reject duplicate JSON keys; close every nested semantic object; validate application family, normalization fields, source-render generation and independent content hash, exact target/sentinel ID and role tuples, all Windows normalization rules and casefold uniqueness; add a negative for every field.

Add deterministic policy probes for every sustained bypass and safe actual-Windows tests for root/parent substitution, cleanup substitution, reparse chain, target contention, access denial, process exit, PID reuse, partial inventory, executable ambiguity and arbitrary-path rejection. Formal harness coverage_unavailable remains non-PASS.

Create a newly named acyclic draft freeze with new hashes. Obtain fresh policy and native peer checks, root technical crosscheck, adversarial premortem and boss ruling. No PASS, code lock, release or launcher authority transfers from this rejected generation.
